171: def fit_train_whitener(embeddings: np.ndarray, train_ids: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
172:     """Fit fixed alpha=0.05 shrinkage whitening from train items only."""
173:     train = np.asarray(embeddings[train_ids], dtype=np.float64)
174:     mean = train.mean(axis=0)
175:     centered = train - mean

177:     eigenvalues, eigenvectors = np.linalg.eigh(covariance)
178:     alpha = 0.05

180:     inverse_sqrt = 1.0 / np.sqrt(regularized)

182:     return mean.astype(np.float32), transform.astype(np.float32)
